data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Live Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Implement a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for various metrics.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is displayed as a line chart.
Stage completion rates are shown as a bar chart.
Success rate trends are visualized as an area chart.

features.title: Chart.js Visualization Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize data such as pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking and success rates are displayed with charts.
Charts are interactive and visually appealing.

features.title: Pipeline Visualization
features.description: Develop an 8-stage pipeline visualization using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: The pipeline is accurately represented in 8 stages.
Each stage is clearly labeled and distinct.
The visualization is interactive and informative.

features.title: Feature Metrics Visualization
features.description: Showcase cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Cost tracking metrics are visualized with charts.
Sandboxing and learning metrics are included.
Charts are clear and easy to interpret.

features.title: Code Quality Visualization
features.description: Display TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: TDD compliance is represented in a radar chart.
SOLID principles are included in the visualization.
The radar chart is clear and informative.

features.title: Integration Visualization
features.description: Visualize supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: A pie chart shows supervisor integration across stages.
The chart is accurate and visually appealing.
Integration data is clearly represented.

features.title: Results Slide with Real Metrics
features.description: Showcase real metrics from recent runs using actual data.
acceptance_criteria: The slide includes real metrics from recent runs.
Data is presented accurately and clearly.
The slide aligns with the overall presentation theme.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality for slides with navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate through slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: HTML Presentation Creation
features.description: Develop a standalone HTML file for the Artemis self-demo with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: The HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js is included for data visualizations.

features.title: HERO Slide: Introduction to Artemis
features.description: Create a slide introducing Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: The HERO slide clearly explains what Artemis is.
The design is consistent with the rest of the presentation.
The slide captures the audience's attention.

features.title: Professional Presentation Design
features.description: Design the presentation with a professional gradient background and smooth slide transitions.
acceptance_criteria: The presentation has a gradient background.
Slide transitions are smooth and professional.
The overall design is visually impressive.
